name: Hawk-Dove
summary: Two-player anti-coordination game where players choose to escalate or back down, risking mutual disaster.
rules_text: Two players simultaneously choose one of two actions: Hawk (stay/escalate) or Dove (swerve/back down) without seeing the other's choice. Payoffs are: If both choose Hawk, both receive their worst payoff, e.g. -100 each. If one chooses Hawk and the other Dove, the Hawk gets its best payoff (e.g. 1) and the Dove gets a low payoff (e.g. -1). If both choose Dove, both get a modest intermediate payoff (e.g. 0). Formally with payoffs (a,w) for Hawk/Hawk, (b,x) for Hawk/Dove, (c,y) for Dove/Hawk, (d,z) for Dove/Dove, the ordering is b>d>c>a for Player 1 and y>z>x>w for Player 2. The game is one round.
rating_reason: Classic 2-player simultaneous strategy game, fits payoff matrix
